step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Accenture's Circular Supply Chain solution. Data from IoT devices in the field is ingested by AWS IoT Core, which triggers an AWS Lambda function. The function routes data through an Application Load Balancer (ALB) into a Hyperledger Fabric blockchain hosted on Amazon EKS. Data is synchronously/asynchronously mirrored off-chain into Amazon DynamoDB, then exported to Amazon S3 and ingested into Amazon SageMaker for predictive analytics. Smart contract events trigger notifications via Amazon SNS to mobile end-users/drivers. The blockchain nodes on EKS are monitored by Amazon CloudWatch and secured with key management backed by AWS CloudHSM.

edges.notes: IoT Core triggers Lambda function based on sensor data
Lambda forwards requests to Application Load Balancer
ALB writes transaction data to EKS blockchain nodes
Blockchain data is mirrored off-chain to DynamoDB
DynamoDB exports data to S3 bucket
S3 feeds data into SageMaker for predictive analytics
Smart contract triggers notification on threshold exception
SNS alerts drivers/users regarding produce rerouting
EKS container metrics and logs sent to CloudWatch
CloudHSM manages cryptographic keys for blockchain operations
